hypothesis_text: Gemma 4 produces highly deterministic strategic responses in repeated games — across our 100-round PD run the model never deviated from a mirror-the-opponent policy, suggesting the model implements a robust internalized strategy.
flaw_description: All runs were executed at temperature 0.0, which collapses the output distribution to greedy decoding. 'Never deviated' under temperature 0 is mechanically expected and is evidence about decoding parameters, not about the strength or robustness of an internalized strategy. The robust-strategy claim requires temperature sweeps; at T=0.7 a different picture is plausible.
expected_critique_targets: T=0.0 is greedy decoding — non-deviation is by construction
robustness claim not supported by single-T data
stochastic decoding may reveal alternative actions
context: All Day-7 PD runs at T=0.0; the 7.2 diagnostic was T=0.7 but with no claim about strategy robustness.
